gdpExpenditure.metaDescription: What Georgia’s GDP is spent on: household and government consumption, investment, exports and imports over time, with Geostat sources and Excel downloads.
gdpExpenditure.heading: GDP by expenditure
gdpExpenditure.nominalContext: Current prices. Imports are shown as positive amounts and are subtracted from GDP.
gdpExpenditure.shareContext: Share of the same year’s GDP. Because of imports, the shares do not add up to 100%.
gdpExpenditure.growthContext: Annual growth, adjusted for price changes. Households and non-profits are combined.
